concerns.text: Task T032 is marked as incomplete/unchecked. This task is required to update `data-model.md` with the gravity anomaly frame of reference definition. Without this task completion, the data model entity 'Gravity Anomaly' (Spec Key Entities) lacks the necessary theoretical definition required before Phase 2 (Data Ingestion) can proceed, leaving FR-003 and SC-001 unimplementable.

Task T017c (Merge and validation script) is marked as incomplete/unchecked. This task is the sole implementation of the 'merged_monthly.csv' artifact required by SC-001 (≥90% completeness) and the input for US-2 (T020). Its absence means the data ingestion pipeline (US-1) cannot produce the verified output required to satisfy FR-001, FR-002, and FR-003.

Task T023 (Contract test for correlation schema) and T024 (Integration test for correlation pipeline) are marked as incomplete/unchecked. These tasks are required to validate the 'Correlation Result' entity (Spec Key Entities) and satisfy the 'Independent Test' criteria for US-2. Without them, the statistical analysis phase cannot be verified against FR-004, FR-005, and FR-008.

Tasks T025 through T031 (Visualization and Sensitivity Reporting) are all marked as incomplete/unchecked. These tasks are required to implement US-3, satisfying FR-006 (Sensitivity analysis), FR-007 (No causal language), FR-009 (Temporal bias), and SC-003 (Threshold sweep). The absence of these tasks leaves the entire User Story 3 unimplemented.

Tasks T037 through T044 (Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns) are marked as incomplete/unchecked. Specifically, T040 (Runtime measurement) is required to verify SC-004 (≤6 hours runtime). T038/T039 are required to verify the end-to-end pipeline. The absence of these tasks means the project cannot satisfy the final success criteria or the 'Independent Test' for the full system.

Task T033 contains a stale internal marker '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_7d6c40a7 — status=not_enough_info]' within the task description. This appears to be a draft artifact or a copy-paste error from a previous review cycle that should be removed to maintain document clarity.
